scripts.dev: bun run --cwd packages/orchestrator template-config && bun scripts/dev-config.ts MOCK_SANDBOX_URL=http://localhost:9797 PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:8787 && wrangler dev -c packages/ingress/wrangler.test.jsonc -c packages/orchestrator/.wrangler/dev/wrangler.jsonc --var ADMIN_DEBUG:true --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.smoke: bun run --cwd packages/orchestrator template-config && bun scripts/smoke.ts
scripts.sandbox:build: bun run --cwd packages/sandbox-bridge build && docker build --platform linux/amd64 -f packages/orchestrator/sandbox/Dockerfile -t artfct-sandbox:local .
scripts.check: turbo run test lint build lint:root fmt:check
scripts.check:affected: turbo run test lint build lint:root fmt:check --filter=...[${TURBO_SCM_BASE:-main}] --filter=//
